title: Getting Started with peacock
text: peacock simple package helps start new R projects quickly. Instead manually creating folders files every time, peacock sets sensible defaults. guide shows use function package.

title: Getting Started with peacock
text: peacock follows three principles: Start fast - Get working project structure seconds Stay organized - Pre-configured folders keep work tidy Work way - Modify templates fit workflow

title: Getting Started with peacock
text: peacock provides four main functions: init_shiny() - Create Shiny app structure init_template() - Pull GitHub project templates init_changelog_md() - Add changelog file tool_review_template() - Set tool comparison projects

title: Getting Started with peacock
text: common use case starting new Shiny application.
code: # Create a Shiny app in the current directory init_shiny()  # Create in a specific location init_shiny(path = "~/projects/my_dashboard")  # Skip confirmation prompt (useful in scripts) init_shiny(path = "~/projects/my_dashboard", confirm = FALSE)

title: Getting Started with peacock
text: run init_shiny(), get: Main files: - ui.R - User interface definition navbar structure - server.R - Server logic (empty ready use) - global.R - Load libraries, data, shared objects Organized folders: - modules/ - Modular Shiny components (includes example module) - userInterface/ - UI components split page - R/ - Helper functions utilities - www/ - Static assets (CSS, JavaScript, images) - data/ - Data files - dev/ - Development scripts Configuration: - Dockerfile - Ready deployment - .gitignore - Pre-configured R projects - .Renviron - Environment variables

text: Keep log ’ve done init_changelog_md(). creates CHANGELOG.md structure:
code: # Add a changelog to your project init_changelog_md(path = "~/my_project") # CHANGELOG  ``` txt YYYY-MM-DD  John Doe  * Big Change 1 * Another Change 2 Replace the template content with your actual changes. This is helpful for:  - Documenting what you did and when - Sharing progress with collaborators - Remembering why you made certain decisions  ## Comparing Multiple Tools  When you need to evaluate several tools or methods, `tool_review_template()` creates an organized structure.   ``` r # Compare three bioinformatics tools tool_review_template(   tool_name = c("STAR", "HISAT2", "Salmon"),   tool_url = c(     "https://github.com/alexdobin/STAR",     "http://daehwankimlab.github.io/hisat2/",     "https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/salmon"   ),   path = "~/research/rna_seq_comparison" )

title: peacock 0.2.0
text: init_template() now accepts GitHub repository "owner/repo" "owner/repo@ref" (branch, tag, commit), addition built-names. Templates defined data-file registry, download targets repository’s default branch (HEAD) instead hardcoded main. peacock_templates() lists built-templates. custom registry (DCF YAML) can supplied via registry argument. init_analysis() scaffolds reproducible analysis project (raw/processed data, analysis notebooks, reusable functions, outputs). init_quarto() scaffolds Quarto website, book, manuscript. init_python() emits modern Python project (src layout, pyproject.toml ruff pytest). peacock stays R package. Every project scaffold - init_shiny(), init_analysis(), init_quarto(), init_python(), tool_review_template() - now also writes AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md AI coding assistants productive immediately.

title: peacock 0.2.0
text: Added testthat (edition 3) test suite cross-platform R CMD check GitHub Actions workflow (Ubuntu, Windows, macOS). Adopted Air formatter, enforced CI.

title: peacock 0.2.0
text: init_template() validates template argument fails fast clear message unknown names; download wrapped error handling always cleans temporary directory. tool_review_template() uses seq_along() (previously errored empty tool_name) now populates new empty src/ scripts. Shiny Dockerfile CMD uses valid quoting (previously backticks). Confirmation prompts shown interactive sessions, scripted use longer silently cancels.

title: peacock 0.2.0
text: peacock now released MIT license (previously GPL-3). Added package hex-sticker logo (Indian folk-art style), companion overview graphic, browser-tab favicons documentation site. init_* scaffolding functions now return created path invisibly.

title: peacock 0.1.0
text: init_shiny() - Initialize complete Shiny application structure organized folders modules, UI components, data, static assets. Includes Dockerfile deployment. init_template() - Download set project templates GitHub repositories. Currently supports “shiny” “cgds” templates. init_changelog_md() - Create CHANGELOG.md file simple format tracking project progress changes. tool_review_template() - Set organized structure comparing multiple tools methods, dedicated folders tool’s data, scripts, outputs.
